note: Version is NOT reliable from the plugin DLL FileVersion (NINA doesn't stamp it meaningfully). It IS reliably logged by NINA's PluginLoader on every successful load, e.g. 'Successfully loaded plugin <Name> version <Version> by <Author>'. Enforcement here means: verify the pinned version was the one most recently logged as loaded. There is NO official API/CLI to install or update NINA plugins; NINA's Plugin Manager (GUI) is the only sanctioned path. This tool CAN download+checksum-verify the plugin archive from the community manifest repo and drop it into pluginFolderPath (mirroring what NINA does internally), but this is unofficial - NINA must be closed during the copy and restarted afterward to pick it up. This file lives in the same 'imaging-app' module as nina.json - if NINA is ever swapped for another sequencer (e.g. Sequence Generator Pro), replace both files together with that app's own equivalents.
